from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import random

mol = Chem.MolFromMolBlock(open("mol_0138.mol").read(), removeHs=False)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)

params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 42
cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
print("embed:", cid)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=2000)

# verify stereochemistry retained after embedding
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
codes = {a.GetIdx()+1: a.GetProp('_CIPCode') for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')}
print("CIP after 3D:", codes)

Chem.MolToMolFile(mol, "mol_0138_3d.mol")

# write xyz
conf = mol.GetConformer()
lines = [str(mol.GetNumAtoms()), "mol_0138 3D structure"]
for i, a in enumerate(mol.GetAtoms()):
    p = conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
    lines.append(f"{a.GetSymbol():<3} {p.x:12.6f} {p.y:12.6f} {p.z:12.6f}")
open("answer.xyz","w").write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
print("wrote answer.xyz")
EOF

import numpy as np
lines = open("answer.xyz").read().split("\n")
n = int(lines[0])
coords = np.array([[float(x) for x in l.split()[1:4]] for l in lines[2:2+n]])
els = [l.split()[0] for l in lines[2:2+n]]
d = np.linalg.norm(coords[:,None,:]-coords[None,:,:], axis=-1)
np.fill_diagonal(d, 1e9)
print("min interatomic dist:", d.min())
# bonded pairs check: count distances < 1.2 (too close) 
print("pairs < 0.9 A:", (d < 0.9).sum()//2)
# typical bond range
import itertools
nb = [(i,j,d[i,j]) for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(n),2) if d[i,j] < 1.75]
print("num bonds-ish:", len(nb))
print("max of those:", max(b[2] for b in nb))
